title: Color / header palette
slide_intent: Introduce the dominant color relationships so viewers can recognize the palette before studying its rules.
strategic_value: Red against restrained light and dark fields can make DB’s identifying accent memorable.
demonstration: Three labeled swatches—DB Red, White and Cold Black—sit on a dark field above a red sleeper strip.
practical_value: Compare the visual contrast of the core colors without inferring usage percentages.

content_islands.name: Core swatches
content_islands.spec: Align red, white and dark swatches with their names.

content_islands.name: Sleeper motif
content_islands.spec: Place the red strip along the lower edge of the dark header.

reference_purposes.Expression: The header presents DB Red, White and Cold Black as a contrasting palette.
